name: 모호한 언어 감지
description: 감지합니다 패턴 of 헤징 and epistemic markers 텍스트에서, as AI tends to use excessive cautious language and qualifiers.
useCase: Identifying AI 생성 text through overuse of uncertainty markers and safety qualifiers
mechanism: 식별합니다 헤징 expressions (modal verbs: 'might', 'could', 'may'; adverbs: 'potentially', 'possibly', 'arguably'; phrases: 'it is worth noting', 'it should be mentioned') and computes their frequency relative to assertive language. AI systems, especially instruction-tuned models, systematically overuse 헤징 to appear balanced and avoid making definitive claims, creating a measurable 통계적 signature.
source: Liang, W. et al. (2024) - Mapping the Increasing Use of LLMs in Scientific Papers, arXiv
algorithm: Hedging Lexicon Matching + Assertiveness Ratio + Modal Verb Frequency Analysis
parameters: Hedge lexicon: 200+ expressions, Categories: epistemic/approximative/plausibility shields, Ratio: hedge-to-assertion, Normalization: per 100 words
strengths:
• 인스트럭션 조정 LLM의 알려진 체계적 편향 포착
• 학술 및 전문 텍스트에서 잘 작동
• 낮은 계산 비용
• 결과 해석이 용이
limitations:
• Scientific writing naturally contains 헤징
• Cultural differences affect 헤징 norms
• Base models hedge less than RLHF-tuned ones
• Simple paraphrasing can remove 헤징
